name: Beata Luise Busch
notes:
See notes appearing on the record of Christian Pfeiffer.
See also the translation of Record # 48, LDS Film # 758374 recording the birth of Maria Elisabeth Pfeiffer on the 23rd of September, 1813, wherein it states that the wife of Christian Pfeiffer, a Beate Luise Busch was 21 years of age.  This implies a birth date of 1792, or 1 year earlier than the record of Christian Pfeiffer.  The exact birth date is not known at this time.
